hero.caption: Santa Maria del Fiore
hero.alt: Pen and ink sketch of Brunelleschi’s dome and Giotto’s bell tower

neighborhoods.name: Historic center (Duomo, Signoria)
neighborhoods.tip: You’re in the middle of it. Most sights are a short walk. Nearest main taxi rank: Piazza della Repubblica.

neighborhoods.name: Santa Maria Novella and San Lorenzo
neighborhoods.tip: Next to the main train station, which has a 24-hour taxi rank. The T2 tram to the airport leaves from Unità, nearby.

neighborhoods.name: Santa Croce
neighborhoods.tip: The lively east side of the center, with leather workshops and evening bars. For a taxi, call or walk to Piazza della Repubblica.

neighborhoods.name: San Marco
neighborhoods.tip: A few minutes from the Accademia (David). There’s a main taxi rank at Piazza San Marco.

neighborhoods.name: Oltrarno (Santo Spirito, San Frediano)
neighborhoods.tip: Across the river on the artisans’ side, close to Pitti and Boboli. Call 4242 or 4390 for a taxi.

neighborhoods.name: San Niccolò
neighborhoods.tip: Below Piazzale Michelangelo and San Miniato. Lovely for sunset walks, uphill in places.

neighborhoods.name: Fiesole (in the hills)
neighborhoods.tip: A hill town above the city. Bus 7 runs down to the center. At night, call a taxi ahead; they rarely wait up there.

airports.name: Florence airport (Peretola)
airports.tip: Taxi to the center is a flat €28 by day, €32 at night. The T2 tram is the cheap option.

stations.name: Santa Maria Novella station
stations.tip: Florence’s main station, with a 24-hour taxi rank out front. Trains to Pisa, Lucca, Siena, Bologna and beyond.

items.title: Walking
items.text: The historic center is compact and mostly flat. Most sights are 5 to 20 minutes apart on foot. Much of it is closed to ordinary traffic, so walking is often quicker than a taxi.

items.title: Taxis
items.text: No street hailing. Go to a taxi rank or call. More in Taxis, below.

items.title: Tram to the airport
items.text: The T2 tram runs between the airport and Unità, near Santa Maria Novella station.

items.title: Trains out of town
items.text: Day trips to Pisa, Lucca, Siena and Bologna leave from Santa Maria Novella station.

taxis.intro: Go to a taxi rank or call. Main ranks: Santa Maria Novella station (24 hours), Piazza della Repubblica, Piazza San Marco.
taxis.apps: The itTaxi and appTaxi apps book the same licensed cabs without a phone call.

fixed_fares.label: Airport ↔ center
fixed_fares.note: Official flat fare between the airport and central Florence. Bags are €1.20 each.

supplements.label: Leaving the airport on the meter

discounts.title: Taxi Rosa
discounts.text: Women riding from 21:00 to 4:00 get 10% off. Ask for it when you call.

taxi_tariff.rush_note: Fares don’t change at rush hour, only by day, night or holiday. Traffic still costs more because the meter also counts time.
taxi_tariff.note: Rough estimate from the city tariff, straight-line distance and light to heavy traffic. The meter decides. Calling for a taxi adds €2.50.
taxi_tariff.source: City of Florence taxi tariff in force from May 2024, the latest official table we found
